about: Reviewed differences between a database and the reference built from the migrations, which verification accepts and always reports. Each entry is pinned to exact catalogue lines (supabase/ops/catalogue.sql): any other difference, a changed fingerprint, or an entry whose difference no longer exists makes verification fail. Change this file only through a reviewed pull request.

entries.reason: The production body of this function contains CRLF line endings, including the three line breaks inside its multi-line dynamic SQL literal passed to execute format('update public.%I set verification_status = $1, ...'). The repository migration 20261109000500 uses LF line endings. The production body matches the repository version when only the line endings are converted: production's raw body fingerprint f9239d98549576c343ba3d93ad8940e2 (from the production verification report of 2026-11-10) equals the MD5 of the repository text with every LF replaced by CRLF (checked on 2026-11-11). The catalogue fingerprint treats CRLF as LF outside string literals, so only the line endings inside this literal remain different. When PostgreSQL parses the embedded SQL, CRLF and LF are equivalent whitespace.
entries.approval: The entry takes effect only once it is on main, because the migration workflow runs only from main. As of 2026-11-13 the main branch ruleset ("Protect main", no bypass) requires a pull request and three passing CI checks ("Lint, types, unit and database tests, build", "End-to-end tests", "Migration runner self-test"); it does not require approval from an independent reviewer. The repository owner, Almirante, is responsible for personally reviewing and merging the pull request that adds this entry; that merge is its approval.
